title: Quick Smoky Ukrainian Umeboshi Skewers
description: A floral and snappy Ukrainian dish featuring umeboshi, smoke-cold, and raw-friendly ingredients, perfect for show-off occasions. This recipe combines the unique flavors of umeboshi with traditional Ukrainian ingredients.
instructions: Soak the bamboo skewers in water for 30 minutes to prevent burning.
Thread a cherry tomato, an umeboshi, and a sprig of fresh dill onto each skewer.
In a small bowl, mix together smoked paprika, garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, and salt.
Brush the mixture onto each skewer, making sure to coat all the ingredients.
Place the skewers on a plate or tray and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, sprinkle additional smoked paprika and chopped fresh dill onto each skewer.
Serve the skewers cold, garnished with additional cherry tomatoes and fresh dill if desired.
For an added smoky flavor, place the skewers under the broiler for 1-2 minutes, watching carefully to prevent burning.
